verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Datalab serves an llms.txt at documentation.datalab.to/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes the docs. The docs also state that llms.txt advertises the OpenAPI spec under an "## OpenAPI Specs" heading, and reference pages have markdown mirrors (.md URLs), so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. Missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents actually consuming these docs, and any llms-full.txt or agent-specific usage guidance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://documentation.datalab.to/llms.txt # Datalab Documentation
